text:
Clinic Desk 7.2 (released 13 October 2026) adds three main features: an online waitlist that texts the next patient when a booked slot is cancelled, with 30 minutes to accept; telehealth video links included in reminder texts and emails; and a practitioner leave calendar that automatically blocks online bookings on leave days.

Improvements include next free appointments shown in the day view, patient search by Medicare number, and per-clinic reminder timing of 24 or 48 hours. Several bugs are fixed, including recurring appointments skipping weeks after public holidays.

One known issue: on some older Android phones, waitlist links open in the browser instead of the app, though patients can still accept there.

Coming next month: SMS two-factor login for staff and a reporting dashboard for practice managers.
